integrity: The complete degree histogram is established by a combinatorial all-length proof; two independent finite verifiers supplement but do not replace that proof.
scientific_limitations: At most one noncircular binary predecessor overwrite; neither optimal code sizes, multiple-grain errors, nor q-ary analogues are addressed. The independent audit is not yet performed, and full historical priority requires independent verification.
title: Exact degree distribution of the binary one-grain confusability graph
